richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jamnagar

c: Jamnagar's brass parts workshops and the large refinery townships nearby give the city two very different outdoor gym buyers. Small unit owners want a few machines for a worker colony, while townships plan full gyms for thousands of residents. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to both, along with schools, colleges and municipal gardens. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 450 km away by road.

Jamnagar sits near the Gulf of Kutch, with dry heat, strong winds and some salt in the air. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats are our standard answer to that mix. We deliver by road, and our installation team or a dealer in western India fixes each machine on a grouted or self-standing base. Tell us the number of residents the gym should serve, and we will size the set and mark it on a layout drawing.

items.q: How many machines does a worker colony in Jamnagar need?
items.a: Two or three shared machines are enough for a small colony. Machines with three seats or two walkers on one frame serve more people in less space.

items.q: Does the coastal wind affect the machines?
items.a: Wind brings sand and some salt. The galvanised frames resist rust, and a fresh-water rinse every few weeks keeps moving parts free of grit.

items.q: Who installs the equipment in Jamnagar?
items.a: Our installation team or a dealer in western India. They fix each machine as per the approved layout drawing, grouted or self-standing.
